body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet for original fictional Glimmer 1986, a tiny mid-engine two-seat angular coupe from a post-apocalyptic 2994 salvage world. Reference is STYLE and SHEET ORDER only, not vehicle shape. DISTINCT pale mint/charcoal two-tone low wedge coupe, short blunt nose with small closed flush rectangular headlamp covers, inset narrow rectangular front marker lamps, angular flying-buttress rear pillars, short vented midengine deck behind cabin, plain segmented horizontal rear lamp units, no real logos or text or badges. Subtle repaired panels and worn paint, distinctive original detailing, not exact replica. Eight views in exactly TWO ROWS of FOUR equal cells: top front, front-right45deg(nose left), right side(nose left), rear-left45deg(nose right); bottom rear, rear-right45deg(nose left), left side(nose right), front-left45deg(nose right). Consistent proportions/styling across views. Orthographic-ish realistic hand-painted textured racing sprites. Fully inside cells with clear gaps. Wide3:1. Genuine transparent background. CRITICAL runtime tires added separately: NO wheels/tires/brakes; every wheel arch completely alpha-transparent open semicircular cutout connected to space below body, never black filled recess. No shadows/background, no opposing tires visible through holes. Compact wheelbase, low coupe roof, two doors.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent dashboard overlay for fictional Glimmer1986 original pale mint and charcoal two-tone compact midengine wedge coupe, worn salvage world2994. Reference1 layout/style only, reference2 car identity. DISTINCT angular 1980s dashboard with straight horizontal charcoal padded brow, mint-painted side metal and black mechanical switchgear, narrow rectangular vents, offset stacked center-console controls. LEFT HAND DRIVE. Large EMPTY dark rectangular instrument recess on lower-left quarter approximatelyx250-800 y540-710 in2000x800. Runtime instruments added separately: no baked gauges or numbers or needles. No steering wheel, hands, logos, text, seats or gearlever blockingview. Clear transparent windshield opening fills upper half, no glass tint or scenery. Dash spans whole loweredge, driver-eye view2.5:1. Realistic hand-painted textured salvage repairs/screws/modestwear, coherent butnotruined. Empty cluster dark opaque, no circularholes. No floatingobjects.
